summary: Allbirds, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to increase an at-the-market (ATM) offering of Class A common stock by up to $48.1 million under a Sales Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets. The filing amends a prior ATM prospectus, which had only $0.3 million in sales from a $50 million facility, and replaces an earlier TD Securities agreement. Shares are sold at market prices on Nasdaq. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No tender, restructuring, or strategic event is present.
